title: Singular Cardinals Hypothesis
exact_target: Does the power set of every singular strong limit cardinal have the smallest cardinality it could have, namely the next larger cardinal? Its behavior is sensitive to additional set-theoretic assumptions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 41 (SET-002). CC BY 4.0.
William J. Mitchell, On the Singular Cardinal Hypothesis, arXiv:math/9204202 (1992), Section 1, opening definition and Theorem 1.1.
